title: Radiomics Signature on Magnetic Resonance Imaging: Association with Disease-Free Survival in Patients with Invasive Breast Cancer

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Radiomics Signature on Magnetic Resonance Imaging: Association with Disease-Free Survival in Patients with Invasive Breast Cancer》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Purpose: To develop a radiomics signature based on preoperative MRI to estimate disease-free survival (DFS) in patients with invasive breast cancer and to establish a radiomics nomogram that incorporates the radiomics signature and MRI and clinicopathological findings.Experimental Design: We identified 294 patients with invasive breast cancer who underwent preoperative MRI.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Radiomics Signature on Magnetic Resonance Imaging: Association with Disease-Free Survival in Patients with Invasive Breast Cancer》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】The radiomics nomogram estimated DFS [C-index, 0.76; 95% confidence interval (CI); 0.74-0.77] better than the clinicopathological (C-index, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.70-0.74) or Rad-score-only nomograms (C-index, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.65-0.69).Conclusions: The radiomics signature is an independent biomarker for the estimation of DFS in patients with invasive breast cancer.
